messages:
maria: FYI NovaCart dedicated pool-3 is oscillating since ~10:47 PDT. Customers seeing 429s and p99s jump to 28–35s. Scale-up then immediate scale-down repeatedly.
opsbot: autoscaler(event): pool=pool-3 action=scale_down reason=low_util threshold=0.25 metric=cpu_avg replicas_before=8 replicas_after=4 ts=1837654340
dan: Looking at telemetry: the CPU moving avg shows a sawtooth pattern, but request_queue_depth spikes line up with the scale-down events. Link: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/pool-3/telemetry
ashwin: Can we be sure it's noisy neighbor vs metric aliasing? I see one instance with sustained kernel-level OOM kills on other tenant at the same host around the same time. That could have pushed scheduling latencies and tripped our CPU-based autoscaler.
lina (cs): Customer repro: POST /v1/generate with a 6k-token prompt, concurrency 6. They said it started failing mid-run with 429s. Paul forwarded logs: 429s correlate with scale events.
paul (support): Repro steps I used: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"nova-3b-q","prompt":"<6k token payload>","max_tokens":1024}' &
```
With concurrency: run 6 parallel curls for 3 minutes. Saw ~15% 429s during the window.
dan: Two thoughts: (1) Our autoscaler is too reactive to instantaneous CPU dips — smoothing window is 30s. (2) Scale-down step allows halving replicas immediately which amplifies oscillation.
maria: Proposed immediate mitigation: increase scale_down cooldown to 120s, add min_replicas=6 for pool-3, and limit scale_delta_pct to 25%. Can we hotpatch?
ashwin: Also recommend switching primary metric to request_queue_depth with a longer aggregation (60s avg) for inference pools that run mixed-length workloads. CPU alone underestimates tail pressure.
paul (support): If we do min_replicas=6, we can tell NovaCart that we applied a temporary safety floor — helps customer SLA.
dan: I can push config: 
```
autoscaler:
  pool: pool-3
  min_replicas: 6
  scale_down:
    cooldown: 120s
    max_delta_pct: 25
  metrics:
    primary: request_queue_depth
    smoothing_window: 60s
```
I'll roll to canary 1/3 of hosts and monitor for 15m.
opsbot: deploy(config): user=dan target=canary hosts=3/9 id=cfg-20260315-01 status=started ts=1837654600
maria: Good. Also add a temporary alert: increase alert threshold for replica-churn and notify #eng-sre on >3 scale events in 10m so we catch regressions.
dan: Canary finished: no new 429s in canary window, p99 down to 8s. Rolling to remaining hosts now. opsbot will post progress.
opsbot: deploy(config): id=cfg-20260315-01 status=done hosts=9/9 ts=1837654820
ashwin: After roll, we still saw one small bump when a noisy VM had IO pressure — but min_replicas kept customer requests alive. Long-term: schedule node isolation for multi-tenant inference or move NovaCart to a dedicated node class if they want absolute stability.
maria: Thanks everyone. I'll file an incident note and follow up with NovaCart CS with the mitigation + longer-term options (dedicated node class or private deployment). Closing thread unless someone wants to add a ticket link.
